description: Canonical frozen stage/task identity register and qualification ladder. Single source of truth: kaggle_stage_identity.py loads this file and every wrapper/validator resolves its task identity through it, so no script restates these constants.

qualificationLadder.meaning: environment preflight: topology, VRAM, runtime availability
exact model/tokenizer/runtime load, GPU placement, no silent CPU fallback, one trivial generation, runtime still alive
dedicated frozen response-protocol smoke over kaggle-protocol-smoke.jsonl
bounded frozen English benchmark smoke: a registered frozen prefix subset of the canonical full screen
complete 1943-case English Core screen; promotion-quality English evidence

smoke.subsetRule: frozen standalone protocol-smoke artifact; explicitly NOT derived from --limit over the full screen
smoke.note: This is the already-wired Q2 protocol smoke. Routing is preserved, not rebuilt.

benchmark-smoke.subsetRule: registered frozen prefix of the canonical full screen; subsetPrefixCount is part of the frozen identity, so `--limit N` is NOT the definition
benchmark-smoke.note: Q3 is bounded English evidence and pipeline qualification, not the complete comparison.

full.note: Promotion-quality. Requires the complete canonical bytes/count/ordered-ID set: no filtering, dropping, or reordering.

word-studio.note: Frozen from a deterministic rebuild of the tracked synthetic seed. The private review key stays out of the tree.

transform.note: Frozen from a deterministic rebuild of the tracked interactive seed. The private review key stays out of the tree.

hashPolicy: artifactSha256 and orderedTaskIdsSha256 are frozen in this register once the artifact is present in the tree. A stage whose hashes are null here is a generated artifact: its identity is frozen instead by prepare-kaggle-benchmark.py into the prepared stage register carried in the preparation receipt, and stage resolution for that stage accepts ONLY a prepared register bound to this file's own SHA-256. A null value with no matching prepared register fails closed rather than accepting unknown bytes.
preparedRegisterPolicy: prepare-kaggle-benchmark.py freezes the generated stages after deterministic preparation and records artifact SHA-256, task count, ordered task-ID SHA-256, and the registered Q3 prefix ordered-ID SHA-256 in receipt.preparedStageRegister. The block is bound to stageManifestSha256 (this file) and benchmarkRevision. A frozen screen is model-visible only: no gold answer is read, hashed, or emitted by preparation or by stage resolution.

unresolvedStages.benchmark-smoke: english-core-fixed-screen.jsonl is generated during preparation and is not committed. Its frozen identity lives in receipt.preparedStageRegister.stages['benchmark-smoke'], written by prepare-kaggle-benchmark.py after the deterministic build; until preparation has run and that register is present, this stage fails closed.
unresolvedStages.full: Same as benchmark-smoke: the 1,943-case canonical screen is generated during preparation, so its frozen identity lives in receipt.preparedStageRegister.stages['full'] rather than in this checked-in file.
